name: Garrus Ashford
source_profile:
Marquis Garrus Ashford 
The youngest of the four marquises, Garrus of the Plains, as 
he’s known is a charismatic, hard-riding nobleman of southern 
lineage who prefers the company of ranchers and soldiers to 
courtiers. His apparent informality makes him popular with 
settlers, 
although 
his 
family's 
ambition 
for 
land 
is 
considerable. 
Marquisate of Westbridge 
The mercantile marquisate seated at the town of Westbridge.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 17–17 (source excerpt)
alignment_note: Suggested alignment in index, not an established assignment.
